name: Regenerating Worksheet
description: Composition blueprint for modular interactive practice worksheets with callable categories, dynamic in-place regeneration slots, and wildcards
prompt:
FORMAT BLUEPRINT (Structural Composition & Component Hierarchy — No Style Rules): 1. CALLABLE CATEGORIES & SECTION HIERARCHY: - Structure as a semantic document:
wrapping an intro
followed by modular
containers. - Every section MUST declare its callable category via both id and data-category attribute, e.g.:
- Canonical callable categories include: • vocabulary • phrasal-verbs • collocations • grammar • idioms-and-phrases • focus-points • in-class-practice • self-study - Header Area: Contains document title, category eyebrow, session date/meta, and contextual lesson theme summary. 2. EXERCISE CARD ARCHITECTURE & DYNAMIC SLOTS: - Every exercise item is encapsulated inside a self-contained card:
- Inside each card, wrap the dynamic practice content in an identifiable slot container (class="dynamic-slot" or id ending in "-content" / "-container"). - Arrange atomic pieces flexibly across cards (dialogues, scenario clozes, decision trees, matching grids) to match the learning material rather than a rigid fixed template. 3. IN-BOX REGENERATION ACTIONS (WILDCARDS): - Place an in-box regeneration trigger inside each major exercise card: - Interactive Matching: Multi-item association grids with data-pair="{{pair_id}}" matching attributes. - Dialogue / Tone Repair: Conversational exchanges highlighting awkward phrasing with natural replacement selection. 5. INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK CONTRACT: - Embed lightweight JavaScript logic to provide instant visual validation upon answer submission/selection (evaluating data-answer and data-correct tokens). - All interactivity must be self-contained within the HTML document.
